# load packages and datasets

```{r, message = F}
library(tidyverse)

d3_instLevel = read_csv("../clean_data/d3_instLevel_ds.csv")
d3_sports = read_csv("../clean_data/d3_sports_ds.csv")
d3_coach = read_csv("../clean_data/d3_coach_ds.csv")
```

# eda plots

```{r}
d3_sports = d3_sports %>%
  mutate(
    institution_name = case_when(
      institution_name == "Linfield College" ~ "Linfield University",
      .default = institution_name
    )
  )

nwc = c(
  "Linfield University", "George Fox University", "Whitworth University", "Whitman College", "Pacific University", "University of Puget Sound", "Pacific Lutheran University", "Lewis & Clark College"
)

ds = d3_sports %>%
  filter(sport == "Men's Football", year == 2025) %>%
  mutate(
    color = case_when(
      institution_name %in% nwc ~ "nwc",
      institution_name == "Willamette University" ~ "willamette",
      .default = "d3"
    )
  )

colorpal = c(
  "willamette" = "darkred",
  "nwc" = "blue",
  "d3" = "black"
)


solid = ds %>%
  filter(institution_name %in% nwc | institution_name == "Willamette University")


ds %>%
  filter(!(institution_name %in% nwc), !(institution_name == "Willamette University")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n_athletes, y = op_exp, color = color)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .1) +
  geom_point(data = solid, aes(x = n_athletes, y = op_exp, color = color), size = 2) +
  geom_text(data = solid, aes(label = institution_name), hjust = -.1, size = 2) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = median(ds$op_exp, na.rm = TRUE)/median(ds$n_athletes), color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colorpal) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, max(ds$n_athletes)), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function (x) paste0(x/1000, "k"), limits = c(0, max(ds$op_exp)), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "d3 football operating expenses vs number of athletes",
    subtitle = "dashed line = median op_exp / median n_athletes",
  )
```

```{r}
points = d3_sports %>%
  filter(sport == "Men's Football", institution_name %in% nwc)
  
willamette = d3_sports %>%
  filter(sport == "Men's Football", institution_name == "Willamette University")
  
  
  
points %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = op_exp_per_athlete)) +
  geom_point(color = "grey70", alpha = .4) +
  geom_smooth(se = F, color = "grey70", alpha = .5) +
  geom_point(data = willamette, aes(x = year, y = op_exp_per_athlete), color = "darkred") +
  #geom_line(data = willamette, aes(x = year, y = op_exp_per_athlete), color = "darkred") +
  geom_smooth(data = willamette, se = F, color = "darkred") +
  theme_light() +
  labs(
    title = "Willamette Consistently Spends Less per Athlete",
    subtitle = "Compared with other NWC schools",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Operating Expenses per Athlete ($)"
  )
```


```{r}
d3_sports %>%
  filter(institution_name %in% nwc | institution_name == "Willamette University", year >= 2020) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = fct_reorder(institution_name, op_exp_per_athlete, .fun = median), y = op_exp_per_athlete)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = institution_name == "Willamette University",
        group = institution_name), alpha = .2, position = "jitter") +
  geom_boxplot(aes(color = institution_name == "Willamette University", group = institution_name), alpha = 0) +
  theme_light() +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "Willamette University" = "WU", "University of Puget Sound" = "UPS", "Lewis & Clark College" = "L&C", "Pacific Lutheran University" = "PLU", "Pacific University" = "Pacific", "Whitworth University" = "Whitworth", "George Fox University" = "GFU", "Linfield University" = "Linfield", "Whitman College" = "Whitman"
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "darkred", "FALSE" = "gray70"),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = ""
  )
```


```{r}
library(tidytext)


school_labels = c(
  "Willamette University" = "WU", "University of Puget Sound" = "UPS", 
  "Lewis & Clark College" = "L&C", "Pacific Lutheran University" = "PLU", 
  "Pacific University" = "Pacific", "Whitworth University" = "Whitworth", 
  "George Fox University" = "GFU", "Linfield University" = "Linfield", 
  "Whitman College" = "Whitman"
)



wu_sports = d3_sports %>%
  filter(institution_name == "Willamette University", year == 2025) %>%
  distinct(sport) %>%
  pull(sport)

wu_sports

d3_sports %>%
  filter(institution_name %in% nwc | institution_name == "Willamette University", year == 2025, sport %in% wu_sports) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder_within(institution_name, total_hc + total_ac, sport), y = total_hc + total_ac)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = institution_name == "Willamette University",
        group = institution_name)) +
  theme_light() +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ sport,
    scales = "free_x",
    labeller = as_labeller(c(
      "Women's Basketball" = "WBB",
      "Men's Basketball" = "MBB",
      "Women's Soccer" = "WSOC",
      "Men's Soccer" = "MSOC",
      "Women's Softball" = "Softball",
      "Men's Baseball" = "Baseball",
      "Men's Football" = "Football",
      "Women's Volleyball" = "Volleyball",
      "Men's Track and Field (Indoor)" = "M T&F (I)",
      "Men's Track and Field (Outdoor)" = "M T&F (O)",
      "Women's Track and Field (Indoor)" = "W T&F (I)",
      "Women's Track and Field (Outdoor)" = "W T&F (O)",
      "Women's Lacrosse" = "Lacrosse",
      "Men's Cross Country" = "M XC",
      "Women's Cross Country" = "W XC",
      "Men's Golf" = "M Golf",
      "Women's Golf" = "W Golf",
      "Men's Swimming" = "M Swim",
      "Women's Swimming" = "W Swim",
      "Women's Tennis" = "W Tennis",
      "Men's Tennis" = "M Tennis",
      "Women's Other Sports" = "W Other Sports"
    ))
  ) +
  scale_x_reordered(
    breaks = c()
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "darkred", "FALSE" = "gray70"),
    labels = c("TRUE" = "Willamette", "FALSE" = "Other NWC")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Total Number of Coaches",
    fill = "School"
  )

```
